title: Account migration completed (v2)
description: Event generated when an account migration finishes and the result is reported. Result can be either `SUCCESS` or `FAIL`.

code.title: Migration message code
code.description: The code of message for systems

migration.title: Migration Identifiers Object
migration.description: Identifier sent on start of migration process

status.title: Migration status
status.description: Account migration results. Either success or failure

items.description: Addresses Account identifier generated by pismo.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Copy of the metadata sent on the account_incoming event

pci.title: Whether the program type is inside a PCI context

personal.description: The applicant's personal information, if applicable

external_id.description: A record identifier for external purposes

printed_name.description: The applicant's name to be printed on the card (max. 25 characters)

social_name.description: The applicant social name used for descriptions and printed name

marital_status.description: The applicant's marital status. Valid values (SINGLE, MARRIED, DIVORCED, WIDOWER).

other_id_number.description: Another document number. For example, RG in Brazil

address_type.description: The address's type. Valid values (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, OTHER)

mailing_address.description: Flag indicating if this address should be marked as a mailing address

date.description: The date since the address belongs to the applicant, formatted as yyyy-MM-dd

phone_type.description: The phone's type. Valid values (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL, MOBILE).

company.description: The applicant's company information, when applicable

registration_number.description: The number under which the company is registered

annual_revenues.description: The average monthly revenue for the last 12 months

exchange_mode.title: Whether any foreign transaction should be charged by the exchange rate at the day it occurred or at the statement's closing date

total_installment_credit_limit.description: Total amount granted for a separate account credit limit, e.g. a program-specific credit line.

available_total_installment_credit.description: Available amount for the separate credit limit defined by `total_installment_credit_limit`

currency_code.title: Currency code related to the account.

currency_id.title: Currency ID related to the currency.

external_id.description: A key defined by the client. It can have any format

account_status.description: Current status of the account. Used for internal Pismo processing.

open_due_date.description: Account open due date, if provided and account is overdue

external_id.description: A record identifier for external purposes.

account_status_reason_ext_id.description: External reason ID specifying account restrictions.

inactive_since.description: Mandatory only if the account is in a division/program with dormancy

division_code.description: Code string that uniquely identifies the division.

account_creation_datetime.description: Datetime the account was created (UTC, ISO 8601 format).

account_status_update_date.description: Datetime the account status was updated (UTC, ISO 8601 format). If not provided, the account creation datetime will be used.

business_date.description: Date of the last balance information.

cycle_closing_datetime.description: Indicates at what time the day closes for the account division. ISO 8601

printed_name.description: The name that must be printed in the card

operation.title: Migration Operation
operation.description: If the account migration is a creation or update
